prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for the phase-one spacecraft boss of a side-scrolling Metal Slug-inspired run-and-gun.
Input image 1 is the existing spacecraft design reference: preserve its pointed nose, angular delta wing, upper tail fin, cockpit near the nose and paired rear engines, but face the ship LEFT. Input image 2 is the material/palette reference for the following boss phase: worn military metal, olive gray, rivets, warm steel highlights, mechanical details and strong dark contours. Do not copy the second image's robot shape.
Create a polished genuine 16-bit arcade PIXEL ART atlas on an actual TRANSPARENT background. 1536x1024 landscape composition. Strictly crisp pixel clusters, visible 2-3 pixel source blocks, limited coordinated colors, strong near-black outline and purposeful readable metal shading. No rendered 3D, no smooth gradients, no blurry airbrush, no glow halos, no grain.
Top two thirds: ONE very large complete side-view spacecraft sprite, nose points LEFT, spanning x80..1450, y65..565. Battle-ready retro-futurist spaceplane, squat heavy mechanical design; dirty ivory upper armor, dark desaturated olive-gray machinery, warm bronze turbine bands, a small teal cockpit with visible bald stern villain at controls. Fighter silhouette close to image 1, but much more chunky expressive SNK-style armor construction. Clearly readable thick panel borders, rivets, overlapping armor plates, scratched edges, deep recessed vents, stacked segmented rear engine nozzles pointing RIGHT. Gear retracted, no wheels. Keep two underside hardpoints for small downward vector-thruster attachments, and an unobstructed central underside weapon-well. No fire or exhaust baked into the hull; no floating parts near it.
Bottom third: three separate cleanly isolated matching modular sprites, with at least 60 pixels clear spacing. Left x130..400 y700..980: a compact cylindrical armored vector-thruster pod pointing DOWN, articulated metal pivot at the top, detailed dark nozzle and copper interior at bottom, NO flame. Middle x565..1030 y720..925: a side view retractable belly autocannon pointing RIGHT, round pivot at LEFT, telescoping barrels with steel recoil sleeves, olive armor and copper hardware, NO muzzle flash. Right x1180..1450 y720..920: a matching small 3-tube mortar rack with short upright black barrels and a separate sliding armor lid beside it, NO projectiles. All modules share the exact same scale of pixel detail and light direction.
Everything wholly inside its region. No labels, lettering, grid, background, floor, reflections, shadows outside silhouettes, thruster flames, effects or duplicate hulls. This sheet will be cropped into separately animated parts; ensure truly transparent empty spaces.
